title: Playwright Secure Login POM
description: Playwright Python Page Object Model script for logging into Heroku secure area.
assertions: expect(page).to_have_url('/secure'), expect(flash).to_contain_text('You logged into a secure area!')

title: E-Commerce Checkout Flow Test
description: UI automation test validating cart total calculation, shipping address entry, and order placement.

title: REST API Get Post Contract Test
description: API test validating GET /posts/{id} returns correct JSON schema, status 200, and required fields.
response_schema: { id: number, userId: number, title: string, body: string }

title: REST API User Registration & Rate Limiting
description: API test validating user creation POST /users and rate limiting HTTP 429 compliance.
security_rule: Must return 429 Too Many Requests if request frequency > 100 req/min.
